job.name: ig18_gran_b
job.meaning: бабушка ~75 в очках, бежевая блузка с брошью, квартира с книжным шкафом и коврами, вечер
job.prompt: Photorealistic portrait of a kind intelligent Russian grandmother about 75 with short curly grey hair, thin gold-rimmed reading glasses, a beige blouse with a small vintage brooch. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, medium close shot from the chest up, face large and sharp, top of head about 12% below the upper edge, looking straight into the lens, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, gentle loving expression, kind eyes with smile wrinkles, NO broad smile, mouth relaxed. Natural skin texture with real wrinkles and age spots, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch, NOT airbrushed. No text, no logos, no watermark. Background: a cosy old city apartment with a wall carpet, a bookcase and a floor lamp, softly blurred, warm evening lamp light.
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary elderly person (not a celebrity), looks genuinely real and warm.
